chipSemantics.operatorWaveforms: Four waveforms only when register 0x01 bit5 enables selection; otherwise op_waveform returns sine0. Register0xe0 per operator uses low2bits. OPL1 sine-only semantics do not apply here.
chipSemantics.output: Mono output copied identically to both stereo arrays.
chipSemantics.readSemantics: Even offset aliases return FM status OR 0x06; odd offsets return0xff (inhibit). Timer A0x40, TimerB0x20,IRQ0x80; no busy status bit.

record.reviewScope: Independent read-only review of final YM3812 OPL2 checker,14 input/report hashes and arithmetic main/self/player counter reconstruction. No production or checker source edits by reviewer.

playerFrameDerivation.method: Twice full7168-sample baseline; each seek prefix plus257 continuation consumes authored waits through the next event boundary. Sum rates over3clocks×2builds; delivered seek-discarded frames are not added twice.

reviewedInvariants: YM3812 OPL2 has four distinct audible waveforms when register01 bit5 enables selection. Disabled gate forces sine; high waveform bits are ignored. Independent modulator/carrier selectors affect PCM. Live gate test compares disabled-time writes against reference writes made only after enabling, with matched701-frame sine history.

All9melody channels,2connections×8feedback settings,5distinct drums, all rhythm masks and AM/PM/depth/envelope changes are programmed. Positive FM/additive,feedback,AM/PM and EGT comparisons produce changed PCM.
Timer A first IRQ frame4 and B16; flags0x40/0x20 and fixed0x06 remain visible; masks hide flags/IRQ without stopping timer. Unmask reveals expired flag. Stop plus clear remains cleared after64frames.
Masked TimerA CSM produces audible PCM on each of9isolated channels without normal key-on; status/IRQ remains masked.
Drum physical groups6=bass,7=snare+hiHat,8=tom+cymbal; melody/rhythm unmute matches uninterrupted synthesis progression.
Pending address survives generation and raw reset. Raw reset retains free-running phase; public reset recreates power-on waveform and reapplies JS mute.
Real read/write/IRQ hooks compared at synchronous boundaries; even reads alias status and odd reads return0xff. Internal serialized state is not claimed equivalent.
Owned PCM starts audible, survives same-buffer overwrite and capacity+1 growth. Engine average/hold source counts/remainder and single master gain checked.
Actual VgmPlayer runs9clock/rate routes×6seek positions with no checkpoints. Reset/replay-from-zero continuation matches baseline exactly.
Main bodies/probes, bounded positives and actual VgmPlayer Engine prefetch generation are separate. All frame counters independently recompute.
limits: Exact agreement validates these fixed builds, not original hardware accuracy.
No snapshot state serialization or portability is claimed; exported wrapper lacks that API.
OPL1, OPL3, optional PSG mixing and physical device scheduling are excluded from this checker.
Separate browser4route and narrowed OPL2 UI checks cover browser integration; no physical listening judgement.

record.reviewMode: Independent read-only implementation and completed-report audit; no checker edits or synthesis rerun. This JSON is the review artifact.

coverageReview.opl2Waveforms: Four enabled waveform outputs are nonzero and pairwise distinct. Disabled gate outputs match sine; separate modulator/carrier changes affect PCM; high selector bits compare identically to low2 bits. Live-gate retention compares disabled-time writes against reference writes made after enabling, at an equal source phase.
coverageReview.nineChannelsAndRhythm: Main scenes exercise all nine two-operator channels, both connections and all feedback levels, operator multipliers/envelopes/AM/vibrato, all five drum keys and32 rhythm masks. Positive self-checks confirm audibility, modulation/connection differences and isolated mute/unmute phase progression.
coverageReview.timersAndCsm: TimerA/B first IRQ is asserted at4/16 native frames; stop/clear and mask/unmask are checked independently. Every isolated physical channel has silent ordinary-key-off baseline then audible masked-TimerA CSM with no IRQ. Actual status/read/IRQ hooks are compared per chunk.
coverageReview.resetAndLatch: Raw reset is distinguished from public handle recreation through a mixed noise/LFO/envelope continuation, without claiming independent counter inspection. A pending C0 address is verified across generation and raw reset using data-only writes and a separately explicit-address reference. Public reset/replay covers84 selected settings on both builds.
coverageReview.ownedPcmAndGrowth: Held nonzero PCM survives same-capacity writes and an actual buffer-capacity increase. Engine averaging/holding source consumption and master-gain-once are checked; no claim that the entire WebAssembly memory must physically grow.
coverageReview.playerSeek: Real VgmPlayer baseline/reset/replay plus nine clock/rate configurations and54 seek continuation windows per build use replay from zero. State/checkpoint APIs are explicitly unavailable; checkpoints stay empty.
coverageReview.frameAccounting: Main body and257-frame post-scene probes include both builds and168 additional reset/replay executions. Positive wrapper output frames and actual Engine-rendered Player frames are separate. Player-delivered frames including discarded prefixes, and Engine internal native resampling frames, are not double-counted.
coverageReview.documentation: README, common build guide, current SavePoint addition and YM3812 issue agree with the frozen SDK pin, nine migrated artifacts, preserved earlier outputs, no snapshot, shared81 tests versus four Worklet routes and main-only YM3812 UI. No remoteCI/publication/listening claim.

limitations: This audit verifies implementation/report consistency, not physical YM3812 hardware conformance or subjective listening.
The dedicated checker has no browser, optional PSG, Worklet, Native backend or Mixer coverage. Separate browser evidence is documented with its explicit scope.
Raw state serialization is absent; parity covers observable continuation, reset/replay and seek replay only.
